description: K₃Na₃(NO₄)₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pbcn space group. There are two inequivalent K sites. In the first K site, K is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 2.58-3.17 Å. In the second K site, K is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 2.76-3.01 Å. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.40 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.44 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are four shorter (2.45 Å) and two longer (2.50 Å) Na-O bond lengths. N is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There is one shorter (1.38 Å) and three longer (1.39 Å) N-O bond lengths. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to four K, two Na, and one N atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to three equivalent K, two Na, and one N atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to two K, three Na, and one N atom to form distorted edge-sharing OK₂Na₃N octahedra. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to four K, two equivalent Na, and one N atom.
